verdict.rationale: Okta's first-party SSO docs cover the core of the story: users authenticate once with the IdP and reach all connected apps. A hands-on community user confirms daily use of Okta's UI and its Chrome plugin ("UI is acceptable and Chrome plugin is OKish", though "somehow slow"). However, nothing in the pack documents the employee launcher dashboard itself or how assigned apps are shown there. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the end-user app dashboard/portal, first-party documentation of the browser extension, and evidence that assigned apps are surfaced automatically in the launcher.
